entries.name: TextureProcessorMetal.metallib
entries.role: GPU developer tooling or paravirtual GPU support
entries.note: BifrOSt ships no GPU developer capture tools or paravirtual GPU driver, which are the only users of this shader.

entries.name: tensor.metallib
entries.role: GPU driver support shaders for Apple silicon / Apple GL-over-Metal
entries.note: Apple GPU driver internals (AGX family, GL shim); BifrOSt gets GPU drivers from Mesa/Vulkan (springboard/gpu) so there is no equivalent and no app depends on it

entries.name: ubershader_archive_bin.metallib
entries.role: Core Image filter kernels (colour, blur, composite, generators, distortion)
entries.note: BifrOSt implements the Core Image filter categories as CPU pixel code with the reference parameters; no GPU filter kernels and no CIKernel language, so large images are slower. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: VertexShaders.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Mesh layout models exist as pure data. No vertex shader draws 3D content yet.

entries.name: VECommonMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Video enhancement (deghosting, virtual shutter angle, common video-effect kernels)
entries.note: Frame interpolation exists on the CPU; the deghosting and virtual shutter kernels of the video enhancement library are not implemented.

entries.name: videoDeghostingMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Video enhancement (deghosting, virtual shutter angle, common video-effect kernels)
entries.note: Frame interpolation and temporal accumulation run on CPU rasters; there is no deghosting or shutter-angle filter.

entries.name: videoSuperResolutionMetalLib.metallib
entries.note: only a bicubic CPU upscaler; no learned super resolution. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: virtualShutterAngleMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Video enhancement (deghosting, virtual shutter angle, common video-effect kernels)
entries.note: A temporal accumulation model exists on CPU rasters. There is no virtual shutter kernel.

entries.name: VSTPrecompiledPipelines.metallib
entries.role: Spatial computing / XR compositor and spatial media shaders
entries.note: Spatial computing shader of an Apple XR compositor or spatial media stack; BifrOSt has no XR hardware or compositor to run it.

entries.name: VSTShaders.metallib
entries.role: Spatial computing / XR compositor and spatial media shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has no XR compositor, immersive display or spatial media pipeline, so this spatial shader has no component to serve.

entries.name: TSDDefaultMetalLibrary.metallib
entries.role: Effects shader of TSReading (app or system UI animation)
entries.note: Presentation effects belong to a presentation app that BifrOSt does not ship.
